entities.summary: XSPORT was a Ukrainian multisport TV channel. It began test broadcasting on January 16, 2012, and full-fledged broadcasting on January 22. Until June 10, 2013, it was a monosport television channel: "Hockey," which also included the news online portal xsport.ua
